outlook.statement: The Company is making sincere efforts for the revival of the Business & the management is confident to recover the losses through improved profitability in foreseeable future.

Global castor oil market projected to grow from 812.1 Kilo Tons in 2026 to 891.0 Kilo Tons by 2034 at 1.03% CAGR. Castor oil derivatives market valued at over USD 1.5 billion in 2025, projected to reach USD 2.88 billion by 2034 at 6.90% CAGR.

Management is making sincere efforts for revival of business and is confident to recover losses through improved profitability in foreseeable future; accounts prepared on going concern basis despite negative net worth and accumulated losses of Rs 35,763.86 lakhs

The Holding Company is making sincere efforts for the revival of the Business & the management is confident to recover the losses through improved profitability in foreseeable future. Similarly, the Management of the Subsidiary Companies i.e. Banpal Oil Chem Private limited and NK OIL Mills Private limited is also making sincere efforts to revive the business and the management of the said Subsidiary companies are confident to recover the losses through improved profitability in foreseeable future.

The Group has assessed internal and external information upto the date of approval of the audited financial statements while reviewing the recoverability of assets, adequacy of financial resources, Performance of contractual obligations, ability to service the debt and liabilities etc. Based on such assessment, the company expects to fully recover the carrying amounts of the assets and comfortably discharge its debts and obligations. Hence the management does not envisage any material impact on the audited financial statements of the company for the year ended on 31st March 2026.
